item.title: Booked On Livingston County Warrant
item.description: A Raytown man was booked into the Caldwell County Detention Center following his arrest by Jackson County officers on a Livingston County warrant for alleged failure to appear for a probation violation hearing in September from a conviction for non-support. Bond is set at $15,000 cash only.

item.title: Board Approves Livingston County Health Center Budget
item.description: The Livingston County Health Center 2026 Budget was approved by the board of trustees. The budget includes $1,418,770 in Revenues and $1,286,500 in expenditures. That leaves $132,270 of reserve funds from the 2026 budget.
